Connected by the Outdoors

This month, we head beneath the big waves of Portugal’s Atlantic coast with Hope Zones—an NGO working to restore marine ecosystems through its pioneering Nazaré Regenerative Seaweed Farm. In other stories, get an in-depth look at our new Personal Surf Inflation vest; learn how we reached a new layering paradigm with Nano-Air; and why freeride mountain biking was never in doubt for Braydon Bringhurst.

Activism

Hope Zones Foundation: Regenerating the Ocean in Nazaré

Hope Zones is working to restore marine ecosystems through its pioneering Nazaré Regenerative Seaweed Farm off the coast of Portugal. In collaboration with local fishermen, scientists, and coastal communities, Hope Zones brings together science, ocean conservation, and community engagement to demonstrate how regenerative seaweed farming can contribute to healthier oceans and more resilient coastal economies.
